acceptance: sp_getapplock and sp_releaseapplock accept named (@Resource, @LockMode, @LockOwner, @LockTimeout, @DbPrincipal) and positional arguments, including EXEC @rc = ..., and return SQL Server's status codes (0 granted, 1 granted after wait, -1 timeout, -2 cancelled, -3 deadlock victim, -999 parameter/other error) with SQL Server's errors for invalid modes and owners.

Locks are shared across sessions of the same database with SQL Server's compatibility matrix for Shared, Update, IntentShared, IntentExclusive and Exclusive. Lock timeouts of 0, -1 (bounded by request cancellation) and N ms are honored. Session-owned locks persist until released or the session ends or resets. Transaction-owned locks require an open transaction and are released at the outermost commit or rollback. Locks are reference counted per owner.

APPLOCK_MODE and APPLOCK_TEST return SQL Server's values. Multi-connection tests cover contention, timeout, release, ownership and the generic repro EXEC sp_getapplock @Resource=N'foo', @LockMode='Exclusive', @LockOwner='Session', @LockTimeout=0.
